# Pagination

A numbered page trail with Previous and Next controls. It shows a window of pages around the current one and always keeps the first and last reachable.

Also asked as: paging, pager, next page, page numbers.

**Import:** `import { Pagination } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/Pagination/Pagination.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/Pagination/Pagination.stories.jsx` — Content, Spacing, InteractionStates, Overview, Interactive, Accessibility, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Current, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/Pagination/Pagination.mdx`

**Motion:** change `spatial.default`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations · Motion.

## Usage

Use `Pagination` when a list is split into numbered pages and the user needs to
move between them or jump to a known one — admin tables of sessions, students,
tutors. It is fully controlled: `currentPage` and `totalPages` are required, and
every click calls `onPageChange` with the target page. It holds no state.

Reach for it to page through results too many for one screen: a table's rows,
a search's matches, a long history.

The window of numbers is computed for you. `max` (default 5) centers the
window on the current page, and first and last pages are pinned with an ellipsis
whenever the window does not reach them.

## Motion

Pagination reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Step to the next or previous | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | A page change is Step. |

## Best practices

### It is controlled, so it needs both the page and the handler. {#it-is-controlled-so-it-needs-both-the-page-and-the-handler}

```jsx
// Incorrect — nothing happens on click. The component never tracks a page of
// its own, and without onPageChange each click is preventDefault and stop.
<Pagination currentPage={1} totalPages={12} />

// Correct.
<Pagination currentPage={page} totalPages={12} onPageChange={setPage} />
```

### Text mode is the one that labels its arrows. {#text-mode-is-the-one-that-labels-its-arrows}

```jsx
// Incorrect — in the default `icon` navigator, previousLabel and nextLabel are used only
// as the arrows' accessible names, so these strings are never visible.
<Pagination currentPage={page} totalPages={9} onPageChange={setPage}
            previousLabel="Back a page" nextLabel="On a page" />

// Correct — navigator="text" renders the words; otherwise leave the defaults, which
// already label the arrows "Previous" and "Next".
<Pagination currentPage={page} totalPages={9} onPageChange={setPage} navigator="text" />
```

### Name the navigation when there is more than one on the page. {#name-the-navigation-when-there-is-more-than-one-on-the-page}

```jsx
// Incorrect — two paginated tables produce two landmarks both called
// "Page navigation", the component's default.
<Pagination currentPage={p1} totalPages={4} onPageChange={setP1} />
<Pagination currentPage={p2} totalPages={7} onPageChange={setP2} />

// Correct.
<Pagination label="Sessions pages" currentPage={p1} totalPages={4} onPageChange={setP1} />
<Pagination label="Students pages" currentPage={p2} totalPages={7} onPageChange={setP2} />
```

Do: Each navigation landmark has its own name.
Don't: Two landmarks with the default name are indistinguishable to a screen reader.

### Show a window, not every page. {#show-a-window-not-every-page}

`max` keeps the row short. Page one and the last page stay reachable with an ellipsis between, so a long list never pushes the controls off the screen.

Do: A window of five pages, with the first and last pinned.
Don't: Every page in the row pushes the controls wide.

### Say how many pages there are. {#say-how-many-pages-there-are}

When the total matters, such as a table of sessions, show it beside the pagination: “Page 3 of 12”. The row alone only shows a window.

Do: The total beside the row.
Don't: Only a window of numbers, with no total.

## Accessibility

- **The structure is right.** A `nav` labeled by `label` (default "Page
  navigation") wraps a `ul` of `li`s, and the current page carries
  `aria-current="page"`.
- **Every page has a name.** Each page button is labeled "Page 3", "Page 4", so
  a screen reader never reads a bare number. Naming the `nav` says which list
  the pages belong to.
- **Parts are buttons.** `Pagination.Page` and `Pagination.Navigator` are
  `button` elements: Tab reaches each, Enter and Space activate it, and none
  follows a link.
- **A disabled Navigator stays reachable.** At the first or last page the
  Previous or Next control keeps its tab stop and carries `aria-disabled="true"`;
  activating it does nothing. It is announced as unavailable rather than
  disappearing, which keeps the row from reflowing.
- **The ellipsis is hidden.** It is `aria-hidden`: the pinned first and last
  pages beside it carry the meaning.
- **Pages are not destinations.** If page numbers should be linkable or
  shareable, render your own anchors with real URLs.
- **Focus is a ring inside the segment** (`--focus-ring-width`), and the current page keeps an
  outline in forced-colors mode.

## Related

- For a continuously loading feed, use infinite scroll rather than pages.
- For a step-by-step flow, use `ProgressTracker` with your own step control.
- For a long table, pair pagination with sorting and filtering; on its own it makes a specific row hard to find.

Same group: `Breadcrumb` · `Link` · `Sidebar` · `Tabs`

## Parts

1. **Navigator.** Previous and Next, as a caret alone (named by its label) or as the label text.
2. **Page.** A numbered button; the current one is selected.
3. **Gap.** An ellipsis where the window skips pages; hidden from assistive technology.
4. **Pill.** One bordered, fully rounded row holding every segment, divided by a hairline.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Subtle ink on the surface. |
| Hovered | The subtle neutral hovered fill. |
| Pressed | The subtle neutral pressed fill. |
| Focused | The 2px ring drawn inside the segment. |
| Current | The selected fill and ink, semibold; hover and press do not change it. |
| Disabled | The disabled ground, ink and caret; the control keeps its tab stop with `aria-disabled`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep the default “Previous” and “Next” in text mode. | Rename them “Back” and “Forward”, or shorten to arrows with no name. |
| Name the navigation after what it pages: “Sessions pages”. | Leave two paginations on one page with the same name. |
| Number pages from 1. | Start at 0 or show a range such as 1–10. |
| Use it for lists with a stable order. | Use it for a feed that keeps loading. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `currentPage` | number (required) | — | Current active page |
| `totalPages` | number (required) | — | Total number of pages |
| `onPageChange` | func | — | Called with the page number to move to. |
| `navigator` | enum | `'icon'` | Previous and Next as a caret (icon) or as their labels (text) |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | Row height: default is 32, compact is 24 |
| `max` | number | `5` | Maximum number of visible page numbers |
| `previousLabel` | string | `'Previous'` | Accessible name of the Previous control. |
| `nextLabel` | string | `'Next'` | Accessible name of the Next control. |
| `label` | string | `'Page navigation'` | Accessible label of the navigation region. |
| `id` | string | — | Id set on the `<nav>` element. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the page list, beside `plus-pagination`. |

## Sub-components

### `Pagination.Page`

Implemented as `PaginationPage`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `page` | number (required) | — | The page number, shown as the button text and passed to `onSelect`. |
| `isCurrent` | bool | — | Marks the current page: sets `aria-current="page"` and the current styling. |
| `onSelect` | func | — | Called with the page number when the button is pressed. |
| `label` | string | — | Accessible name; the number alone when omitted. |

### `Pagination.Navigator`

Implemented as `PaginationNavigator`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `direction` | enum | — | `previous` draws a left caret and `next` a right caret. |
| `navigator` | enum | — | `icon` shows a caret named by `label`; `text` shows `label` as visible text. |
| `label` | string (required) | — | The control's name: its accessible name with `icon`, its visible text with `text`. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | — | Keeps the control in the tab order with `aria-disabled`, and pressing it does nothing. |
| `onSelect` | func | — | Called with no arguments when the control is pressed and not disabled. |
